summary: Per-frame position/heading update guarded by a flag at this+0xEC. Reads saved-position components through FloatFieldAccessor/DualFieldRead, computes per-axis deltas, delegates through TwoCallDelegation_2420, then runs flag-based motion branches: a speed/brake reduction path (fields 0xF8/0xFC/0x100, with different clamping under the dword_7D0398 photo/free-camera mode) and a heading-angle branch (adjust + wrap to +/-2π or clamp to +/-π/2). Resolves velocity as sin/cos of the heading times the speed, writes velocity/heading back to fields 0x118/0x11C/0x120, stores the new position at 0x108, and finishes with a virtual call through vtable+44. Called by GameObjectUpdateFrame (004661B0) and StateInitializerWithFlagCheck (00466300).

local_names.v22: delta of the second saved-position component (Y)
local_names.v17: scaled X component passed to OffsetDispatch
local_names.v18: negated scaled Y component passed to OffsetDispatch

local_names.this[62]: speed value at 0xF8, decayed and clamped

Compute per-axis deltas: v28 = v27 - field 65 (this+0x104) and v22 = v26 - field 66 (this+0x108).
TwoCallDelegation_2420 with six local out-parameters (v25, v20, v21, v19, v24, v23) performs an intermediate state transform.
Load the current motion state: v5/v19 from field 72 (this+0x120), v20 from field 70 (this+0x118) and v21 from field 71 (this+0x11C); v20/v21 become the working velocity components.
Flag byte at this+0xF5 selects the speed/brake reduction branch versus the heading-angle computation branch.
Within the speed branch, the flag byte at this+0xF4 combined with global dword_7D0398 selects the direct OffsetDispatch path.
OffsetDispatch(v17, 0.0, v18) with the deltas scaled by 0.0074999998: v28 becomes the +X component and v22 becomes the -Y component.
Decay the speed field: this[62] (0xF8) is reduced by v22 * 0.025.
When dword_7D0398 (photo/free-camera mode) is set, clamp this[62] to the range bounded below by 0.1 * this[64] (0x100) and above by this[63] + this[63] (0xFC).
Otherwise clamp this[62] to the range bounded by this[64] (0x100) below and this[63] (0xFC) above.
Flag byte at this+0xF4: heading adjust v5 -= v22 * 0.0055, then wrap into +/-2*pi (6.2831855) when dword_7D0398 is set, otherwise clamp into +/-pi/2 (1.5707964).
Resolve the velocity from the heading and speed: v20 = sin(v5) * this[62] and v21 = cos(v5) * this[62].
UtilityFunction_1cd0(v25, v20, v21, v19, v24, v23) applies the resolved velocity/heading values.

Write results back: field 70 (0x118) gets velocity X, field 71 (0x11C) gets velocity Y, field 72 (0x120) gets the heading, and field 66 (0x108) stores the second saved-position component read this frame.

Virtual call through the vtable pointer at this+0x0 with the slot at offset +44, invoked as (this, 1); the return value propagates to the callers GameObjectUpdateFrame (004661B0) and StateInitializerWithFlagCheck (00466300).
